recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片可見整片單調、密集排列的中型芽細胞取代骨髓，脂肪空泡幾乎消失，僅零星殘存深染的紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，符合復發 B-ALL 的瀰漫浸潤。
features: Diffuse, densely packed sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells
Cells with scant cytoplasm and round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin
Marked hypercellularity with near absence of fat spaces
Scattered small clusters of residual erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Occasional brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages; megakaryocytes not identified
describe_en: Intermediate-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with scant cytoplasm and finely dispersed nuclear chromatin. Only scattered small clusters of residual erythroid precursors are present, megakaryocytes are not identified, and occasional hemosiderin-laden macrophages are seen. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia in the context of the immunohistochemical results.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated reliably at this power; lineage requires MPO/CD117 versus TdT/CD79a/PAX5 staining.

ddx.dx: Diffuse marrow involvement by small B-cell lymphoma (e.g., CLL)
ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with clumped chromatin and form proliferation centers, and are TdT-/CD34-.
Hematogones are interstitial and admixed with normal trilineage hematopoiesis rather than forming diffuse effacing sheets.
